div.div: 5 الإِبِلُ تَتَمَتَّحُ فِى سَيْرِهَا (tropical:) The camels move their fore-legs alternately تُرَاوِحُ بِأَيْدِيهَا, A, and some copies of the K; in other copies of the K, تَتَرَوَّحُ;) in going along, (K,) like as the drawer of water moves alternately his two arms. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
